title: Gracie Square Bedspread Pattern #6113
author: Spool Cotton Co., Spool Cotton #186 Bedspreads to Knit and Crochet (via freevintagecrochet.com)
notes: Public domain vintage pattern. start: original "Starting at center ch 10. Join." replaced by magic ring. Original heading "3rd, 4th and 5th rnds:" written as "Round 3-5:". Rounds 1-10 are worked in a spiral (no joins): sc wedges grow to 11 sc, then shrink while ch loops multiply (reverse-pineapple sides). Sewing blocks together omitted. Stitch graph: round 3 reads badly (cost 66.5); check where its stitches go.
